explanation: Refused: cos(theta*) = 1.3 is outside the physical domain [-1, 1], so no real center-of-mass polar angle exists. The eta EXCLURAD kinematics also evaluate sqrt(1 - cos(theta*)^2), which would be invalid at this value. W = 1.7 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, and phi* = 90 deg are not the cause of the refusal.
